g.title: Sheet.29
g.desc: The subnet mask tells PC1 that all addresses from 192.168.1.0...
g.text: The subnet mask tells PC1 that all addresses from 192.168.1.0 to 192.168.1.255 are on the same network.(Hence PC2 is on a different network)

g.title: Sheet.69
g.desc: “PC2 is not on my network. Sending the packets to my DGW”
g.text: “PC2 is not on my network. Sending the packets to my DGW”
